anydb:https://www.anydb.com/community/t/.note: Confirmed in official AnyDB release notes: table view became the default, with inline editing, resizable saved columns, direct record creation, and All-view duplication.
Reviewed as a duplicate community announcement; the official June 26 release-notes entry is merged separately.
Official AnyDB roadmap still lists Shopify two-way synchronization as In Progress; do not represent it as shipped or build-ready.

anydb:https://www.anydb.com/support/rele.note: Official release notes confirm chart-data fixes, multi-series pie charts, formula-dialog UX, document-preview sizing, and related reliability fixes.

anydb:https://www.anydb.com/support/road.note: Directional Q2 2026 roadmap only; Now, Next, and Later are not delivery guarantees and every feature still requires release-note or live-product confirmation.

shopify-dev:https://shopify.dev/changelo.note: Shipped GraphQL operations for reading, creating, updating, and deleting Analytics metric targets; validate the target API version before implementation.
Shipped app-scoped automation tokens for CI/CD deployment; confirm current Shopify CLI requirements before configuring pipelines.
App quality checks and reviewer communication are now managed in Partner Dashboard under app distribution.
Shipped automatic CSS subsetting for stylesheet tags; themes should keep component styles colocated and test cross-section dependencies.
Themes can define a global color-palette setting; validate current theme schema syntax before implementation.
Stores can customize machine-readable agents and LLM text endpoints through corresponding Liquid templates; validate theme behavior live.
Feature preview only; test existing customer-account extensions against the refreshed layout before any rollout recommendation.
Relative endpoint paths are supported for Flow action extensions and resolve differently in development versus production.
Developer preview only; Hydrogen's framework-agnostic core is suitable for prototyping, not an unconditional production recommendation.
Hydrogen developer-preview projects can deploy to Vercel; preserve preview status and validate the current starter/runtime contract.
Feature preview with staged rollout; audit assumptions around delivery profiles and Markets before migration or app changes.
Seven additional Settings intents can open contextual admin settings; validate supported intents against current docs.
Developer preview only; field-level filtering and custom webhook payloads require preview-specific validation.
Plus and Enterprise feature preview; apps must test multiple delivery groups and mixed shipping/pickup fulfillment assumptions.
Available in Admin API 2026-07; use the shippingLine field only after version-specific schema validation.
Shopify App Pricing replaces Managed Pricing terminology and supports recurring, usage-based, or combined models in Partner Dashboard.
App Store requirements now constrain Sidekick extensions to core app functionality and prohibit promotional or cross-sell behavior.
Sidekick App Data and App Actions extensions are available; validate eligibility, scopes, and App Store requirements before use.
Storefront Catalog MCP adopted UCP tool names and endpoint shapes; legacy catalog tools had a June 15, 2026 migration deadline.
Merchants must select a standardized uninstall reason; treat the resulting analytics as directional rather than perfect causal data.

shopify-help:https://changelog.shopify.c.note: Available to merchants on Basic and above using the new Markets experience; preserve market and customer-eligibility interaction caveats.
Benchmark Comparisons stopped receiving data and was removed May 19, 2026; use Metric Targets or other current reporting alternatives.
Analytics supports up to four metrics on a line chart and combined bar-and-line comparisons where metric types are compatible.
Shopify Messaging supports SMS automations, subject to sender registration, consent, country, and channel requirements.
The refreshed customizable sign-in layout applies to new customer accounts; legacy-account merchants must confirm migration readiness.
The new POS Editor centralizes payment, receipt, customer, app-extension, Smart Grid, and device-related settings with a phased rollout.
WhatsApp marketing consent can be managed in customer profiles and imports; verify regional consent and messaging-provider requirements.
Shop Pay supports additional Shopify Payments local and regional methods; availability still depends on market, currency, and payment-method eligibility.
The mobile Online Store Editor includes touch-oriented editing and Sidekick on supported phones; confirm device and tablet limitations.
Shopify Collective exposes shipping-performance metrics and a Verified Tracking badge based on carrier-tracking coverage; validate current thresholds.
Smart delivery filters Shopify Messaging audiences using engagement signals and is enabled by default, with merchant controls.
The admin Marketing surface is now Growth; related campaign, attribution, and automation locations may vary by rollout and app availability.
Reviewed as a high-level Editions index; specific operational changes are tracked through their individual canonical changelog items.
Customer events now includes an app-pixel data-access activity log for audit visibility; confirm retention and access behavior live.
